top_signals.title: Yen Swings in Choppy Trading as Intervention Rally Sputters
top_signals.summary: The yen swung between gains and losses after its intervention-driven rally stalled on Friday as the Bank of Japan kept interest rates steady and Governor Kazuo Ueda offered little fresh support for the currency.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
